info.name: CadPortal API
info.description:
REST API of the internal jewelry CAD vault and product management portal.

**Conventions**
- Everything under `/api/v1` needs `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (from `POST /auth/login`), except the
  routes marked as public.
- Roles: `admin` (everything), `designer` (edit designs, seats, CAD, costing), `production` (read, job bags,
  CAD downloads; never sees wastage % or stone rates).
- Weights and money are decimals. They are sent and returned as JSON numbers or strings; never rely on float
  rounding. Grams are rounded to 3 dp, carats to 4 dp when stored.
- Errors are `{"error": "message"}`. A 500 also carries `request_id`, which finds the request in the logs.
- A missing stone matrix row is never treated as 0: the API answers 422 and lists the missing (size, code) pairs.
- Every call (except health checks) is written to the audit log; request bodies are never stored.

Multipart with one `file` part; the kind comes from the file name. The SHA-256 is taken over the original
bytes, then the file is gzipped while it streams to storage. A duplicate checksum is a 409 that names the

item.name: Many job bags in one PDF (max 200)

request.description:
Give `items` and/or `design_ids` (every live variation of those designs) with shared
`metal_code`/`stone_code`. If any bag lacks stone data the answer is 422 listing every affected
variation; with `skip_incomplete` the rest is printed, the skipped codes are in `X-Skipped` and on a last page.

Responses: 200: PDF; 400: Invalid input; 422: Bags with missing stone data

item.name: Export the catalog as CSV in the import format

request.description:
Any role. Holds no wastage or rates. Round-trips into a fresh install.

Responses: 200: CSV

Two shapes. **Items**: `items[]` with `gold_rate_per_g` and `setting_rate_per_pc` (one row per item).
**Selection**: `design_ids` and/or `variation_ids` (max 500) with a single `metal_code`/`stone_code`:
one row per variation plus a total row; all-or-nothing unless `skip_incomplete`.
The last column `stone_pricing` says how each stone line was priced.
`X-Costing-Incomplete` holds the number of variations not costed.

Responses: 200: CSV; 400: Invalid input; 422: Costing data is incomplete (no wastage %, no stone rate, or no matrix row)
